recognize_zh: 整片小至中型腫瘤細胞彌漫分佈，核卵圓、細胞質稀少、細胞間黏著性差，背景為大片嗜伊紅性壞死與出血並散佈核碎片（karyorrhexis），沒有神經纖維基質，符合未分化型神經母細胞瘤；保存不佳限制了細節判讀。
features: Diffuse population of small to medium-sized tumor cells with oval, pale-staining nuclei
Scant cytoplasm and poor cellular cohesion
Extensive eosinophilic necrotic/hemorrhagic background with abundant red cells
Scattered pyknotic and karyorrhectic nuclear debris
No neuropil or rosettes identified; tissue preservation is suboptimal
describe_en: H&E section shows a diffuse population of small to medium-sized tumor cells with oval, pale nuclei and scant cytoplasm set in an extensive eosinophilic, necrotic and hemorrhagic background with scattered karyorrhectic debris. Neuropil, Homer Wright rosettes and ganglionic differentiation are not identified, and suboptimal preservation limits nuclear detail. The morphology is that of a poorly differentiated small round cell malignancy with necrosis. In the given context, findings are consistent with undifferentiated metastatic neuroblastoma, which requires immunohistochemical confirmation (PHOX2B, synaptophysin, chromogranin).

ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma is CD99 membranous and NKX2.2-positive with an EWSR1 fusion and lacks PHOX2B.
Lymphoma cells are CD45-positive with B- or T-lineage markers (and TdT in lymphoblastic), and Burkitt shows a starry-sky pattern with MYC rearrangement.
